from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case with their role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party, e.g., appellant name, company name")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Legal role, e.g., '上诉人', '被上诉人', '申诉人'")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A court fee record found in the judgment."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Fee amount as a number")
    who_bears: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g., '上诉人共同', '某公司'")
    stage: str | None = Field(description="Instance level, e.g., '二审', '一审'")

class CaseNature(BaseModel):
    """The nature or cause of the case."""
    description: str = Field(description="Description of the case cause")

class Verdict(BaseModel):
    """A specific ruling or outcome statement."""
    outcome: str = Field(description="The decision, e.g., '驳回上诉', '维持原判'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Key verbatim text supporting the outcome")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document."""
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of court fee records including amounts and payers")
    case_natures: list[CaseNature] = Field(description="Descriptions of the case type or cause")
    verdicts: list[Verdict] = Field(description="Specific verdict statements and their verbatim text")
